name: handstand kick up
description: A controlled kick from standing into a balanced handstand without a wall. It trains entry, balance and safe exits.
instructions: Stand with one foot forward and your arms reaching overhead.
Place your hands on the floor shoulder width apart, a stride ahead of your front foot.
Swing your back leg up and push off gently with the front leg.
Bring your legs together over your hips and press tall through your shoulders.
Balance as long as you can, then step down or turn out sideways to exit.
